# Zynix AI

> Zynix AI (Zynix Inc., d/b/a Zynix AI) is the AI operating layer for value-based healthcare. It predicts which patients
> need care, embeds the next step in the care team's workflow, and reaches patients by AI voice and text, so every insight
> ends in an intervention. Four pillars: Population Intelligence, Predictive Risk (readmission, mortality, disease
> progression, utilization), the Embedded Care Management Platform and AI Patient Engagement. It is built for ACOs,
> MSOs/IPAs and physician groups, Medicare Advantage health plans, FQHCs and hospital systems.

Last updated: 2026-10-09

Key facts (as of September 2026, from Zynix):
- 1M+ value-based care patients onboarded; customer organizations in 30 states.
- 30+ EHR systems across 300+ connected instances (including Epic, Oracle Health (Cerner), athenahealth, eClinicalWorks,
  NextGen, Allscripts, Greenway and DrChrono), using FHIR, HL7 v2, C-CDA, X12, Medicare CCLF and BCDA, and NCPDP.
- Security: SOC 2 Type II audited (report available on request); HIPAA-aligned safeguards, BAA available; HITRUST CSF
  certification in progress.
- Approved participant in the CMS ACCESS Model, a voluntary CMS Innovation Center model in Original Medicare for
  technology-supported chronic-condition care.
- How the agents work: agents handle outreach, scheduling, reminders and documentation prep within the rules and hours a
  care team sets. Licensed clinicians make clinical decisions and own the billable interactive contact for TCM. Agents
  route clinical questions to the care team; they do not diagnose or recommend treatment. ZynScribe notes stay drafts
  until a physician reviews and approves them.
- Founded 2024. Co-founder and CEO: Jay Chowdappa, MD (ACOs led by him generated $300M+ in shared savings). Co-founder and
  CTO: Gautamdev Chowdary.
- Zynix Inc., 3535 Little Rd, Trinity, FL 34655 · info@zynix.ai · (727) 261-1297
- Announcements: strategic partnership with PBACO Holding (Business Wire, Apr 14 2026); partnership with eternalHealth and
  nirvanaHealth (Business Wire, Jun 2 2026). Press: https://www.zynix.ai/press

## The AI operating layer: four pillars

- [Population Intelligence for value-based care](https://www.zynix.ai/population-intelligence): Population health intelligence for value-based care: one live picture of who needs what, from claims, EHR, ADT, lab and pharmacy data, down to the visit.
- [Predictive Risk: readmission, mortality, ED use](https://www.zynix.ai/predictive-risk): Know who is heading for a readmission, a decline or an ED visit before it happens.
- [Embedded Care Management Platform](https://www.zynix.ai/embedded-care-management): A care management platform inside your team’s workflow: care plans for TCM, CCM and AWVs, tasks with owners and deadlines, escalation by rule and a record.
- [AI Patient Engagement: voice and text agents](https://www.zynix.ai/ai-patient-engagement): AI patient engagement and outreach: voice and text agents for post-discharge calls, AWV and gap outreach, scheduling and after-hours calls. Clinicians decide.

## Platform

- [The Zynix platform for value-based care](https://www.zynix.ai/platform): One platform to connect claims, EHR and ADT data, rank the patients who need attention, and run follow-up with care plans, agents and your care team.
- [Healthcare data foundation: one patient record](https://www.zynix.ai/products-data-platform): Bring claims, EHR, ADT, lab and pharmacy data into one patient record. Codes standardized, identities resolved, ready for worklists. 30+ EHR systems.
- [Population health analytics for VBC](https://www.zynix.ai/zynix-data-analytics): Risk, quality and HCC gap analytics on your claims and clinical data, ranked into worklists your care team can act on this week.
- [Care plans for TCM, CCM, AWVs and gap closure](https://www.zynix.ai/care-plans): Pre-built care plans sequence agents and care team tasks for TCM, CCM, wellness visits and gap closure, and close only when each step is documented.
- [ZynScribe ambient clinical documentation](https://www.zynix.ai/zynscribe): ZynScribe drafts structured SOAP notes from the visit conversation. Nothing is filed or used for billing until the physician reviews and approves it.
- [EHR integrations: Epic, Oracle Health, athena](https://www.zynix.ai/integrations): Zynix connects to 30+ EHR systems across 300+ connected instances, plus claims, ADT, lab and pharmacy feeds, over FHIR, HL7 v2, C-CDA and X12.
- [Security and compliance](https://www.zynix.ai/security): SOC 2 Type II audited, HIPAA-aligned safeguards with a BAA available, and HITRUST CSF certification in progress. Request the SOC 2 report.
- [ZynixLLM: how Zynix AI works safely](https://www.zynix.ai/company-zynixllm): How ZynixLLM supports value-based care workflows, when clinicians step in, and how agents stay within the escalation rules your team sets.

## AI agents

- [AI agents for care operations](https://www.zynix.ai/agents): Agents for post-discharge outreach, chronic care, wellness visits, after-hours calls, scheduling and fax intake, with clinician escalation by rule.
- [How AI agents work with your care team](https://www.zynix.ai/zynix-ai-agents): Agents handle outreach, scheduling, reminders and after-hours intake in three families. Clinical questions go to your care team by rule.

## Who it serves

- [AI for ACOs: TCM, AWVs and HCC gaps](https://www.zynix.ai/audience-segments/acos-msos): TCM, wellness visits, HCC and quality gaps across your attributed panel, worked by agents and your care team, with clinicians making clinical decisions.
- [For MSOs, IPAs and physician groups](https://www.zynix.ai/audience-segments/independent-group-practices): Run wellness visits, transitions of care, chronic care and quality programs across independent practices, whatever EHR each one runs.
- [AI for Medicare Advantage plans](https://www.zynix.ai/audience-segments/health-plans): Member outreach for HEDIS gaps, medication adherence and post-discharge follow-up, with your care managers setting the scripts and taking escalations.
- [AI for health systems: post-discharge care](https://www.zynix.ai/audience-segments/health-systems): ADT-triggered outreach, follow-up scheduling, after-hours access and ambient documentation that work with your EHR across hospitals and clinics.
- [AI for FQHCs and community health](https://www.zynix.ai/audience-segments/fqhcs): Multilingual outreach, after-hours access and preventive screening follow-up for high-barrier populations, with care team escalation built in.
- [AI for ambulatory surgery centers](https://www.zynix.ai/audience-segments/ascs): Referral intake, pre-procedure scheduling and post-op follow-up calls handled by agents, with your staff taking every exception.
- [Solutions for value-based care organizations](https://www.zynix.ai/solutions): Workflows for ACOs, MSOs and IPAs, health plans, health systems and FQHCs: transitions of care, risk adjustment, quality, chronic care and access.

## Use cases

- [Value-based care use cases](https://www.zynix.ai/use-cases): Workflows by program: transitions of care, risk adjustment and quality, chronic care, after-hours access, care navigation and front-office work.
- [After-hours calls for group practices](https://www.zynix.ai/use-cases/after-hours-call-handling-group-practices): After-hours calls answered for independent practices, with next-morning visits booked and symptom questions routed to the physician on call by rule.
- [After-hours access for ACO patients](https://www.zynix.ai/use-cases/after-hours-ed-diversion): After-hours calls answered for attributed patients: routine visits booked, symptom questions routed to your on-call clinician, emergencies sent to 911.
- [After-hours call handling across sites](https://www.zynix.ai/use-cases/after-hours-triage-multi-site): One after-hours process for every site: calls answered, routine visits booked and symptom questions routed to your on-call clinician by rule.
- [After-hours access for FQHCs](https://www.zynix.ai/use-cases/after-hours-triage-multilingual-fqhc): After-hours calls answered in the caller’s preferred language, with next-day visits booked and symptom questions routed to your on-call clinician.
- [Appointment scheduling and no-show follow-up](https://www.zynix.ai/use-cases/appointment-scheduling-no-show): Two-way confirmations that ask what is in the way, reschedule early and offer freed slots to your waitlist, with exceptions routed to front-desk staff.
- [CCM check-ins for independent practices](https://www.zynix.ai/use-cases/ccm-billing-chronic-care): Monthly chronic care check-ins for enrolled patients, with clinical questions routed to the practice and CCM time reviewed by the billing provider.
- [Chronic care management for ACOs](https://www.zynix.ai/use-cases/chronic-care-coordination-scale): Monthly chronic care check-ins across your attributed panel, with symptom and adherence changes routed to care managers and CCM time reviewed by providers.
- [Inbound fax routing](https://www.zynix.ai/use-cases/fax-inbound-document-routing): Every inbound fax read, classified, matched to the patient and routed to the right staff queue, with missing pages and urgent items flagged for review.
- [HCC gap closure for health systems](https://www.zynix.ai/use-cases/hcc-gap-closure-health-system-aco): Pre-visit gap summaries for scheduled patients and outreach to bring in the ones with no visit booked, so HCC gaps close at documented visits.
- [HCC gap closure for ACOs](https://www.zynix.ai/use-cases/hcc-gap-raf-optimization): Rank open HCC gaps, prepare clinicians before scheduled visits and invite patients with no visit booked, so conditions are documented before year-end.
- [Risk adjustment outreach for MA plans](https://www.zynix.ai/use-cases/hcc-risk-adjustment-ma): Invite Medicare Advantage members with undocumented chronic conditions to a visit, and give providers the open gaps before the member arrives.
- [HEDIS gap outreach for health plans](https://www.zynix.ai/use-cases/hedis-stars-quality-improvement): Two-way member outreach for open HEDIS measures: find the barrier, book the screening, lab or visit, and route clinical questions to care managers.
- [High-utilizer member outreach](https://www.zynix.ai/use-cases/high-utilizer-member-management): Keep routine contact going with high-utilizer members between case management calls, and flag rising utilization before the next admission.
- [Medication adherence outreach for MA plans](https://www.zynix.ai/use-cases/medication-adherence-chronic-populations): Find out why members stopped filling diabetes, blood pressure or statin medications, and route side effects, cost and access questions to the right team.
- [Adherence check-ins for FQHC patients](https://www.zynix.ai/use-cases/medication-adherence-complex-chronic): Two-way medication check-ins for patients on complex regimens, in their preferred language, with side effects and cost barriers routed to your team.
- [Ambient clinical documentation with ZynScribe](https://www.zynix.ai/use-cases/physician-documentation-ambient-ai): ZynScribe drafts structured visit notes from the conversation for physician review. Nothing is filed or used for billing until the physician approves it.
- [Post-discharge follow-up for health systems](https://www.zynix.ai/use-cases/post-discharge-follow-up): ADT-triggered outreach after every discharge, follow-up visits booked inside the TCM window and clinical questions routed to your nurses by rule.
- [Post-discharge follow-up for FQHCs](https://www.zynix.ai/use-cases/post-discharge-followup-fqhc): Outreach after a hospital stay in the patient’s preferred language, with barriers routed to your care team and the follow-up visit booked at your center.
- [Post-discharge follow-up for MA members](https://www.zynix.ai/use-cases/post-discharge-ma-members): ADT-triggered outreach for Medicare Advantage members after a hospital stay, with care managers setting the scripts and taking every clinical question.
- [Post-discharge TCM for ACOs](https://www.zynix.ai/use-cases/post-discharge-tcm-readmission): ADT-triggered outreach for attributed patients, nurse-led TCM contacts inside the 2-business-day window and follow-up visits booked with primary care.
- [Post-procedure follow-up calls for ASCs](https://www.zynix.ai/use-cases/post-procedure-followup-complication): Follow-up calls after outpatient surgery on the schedule your surgeons set, with wound, pain and medication concerns routed to your clinical team.
- [Preventive screening outreach for FQHCs](https://www.zynix.ai/use-cases/preventive-screening-gap-fqhc): Outreach for open screening orders that asks what is in the way, books the visit and routes transportation or cost barriers to your care team.
- [Prior authorization paperwork for specialty care](https://www.zynix.ai/use-cases/prior-auth-high-volume-specialty): Payer responses for specialty authorizations read, matched and routed to the right person, with approved cases scheduled while your staff own each request.
- [Authorization paperwork for surgery centers](https://www.zynix.ai/use-cases/prior-auth-surgical-procedures): Payer responses for surgical cases read, matched and routed to the right person, with approved cases confirmed while your staff own every request.
- [Prior authorization paperwork for practices](https://www.zynix.ai/use-cases/prior-auth-workflow-management): Payer responses read, matched and routed to the right person, and approved visits booked, while practice staff keep ownership of every request.
- [Referral tracking and leakage prevention](https://www.zynix.ai/use-cases/referral-coordination-leakage): Follow each referral until the specialist visit happens and the result returns to the referring provider, with stalled referrals routed to your team.
- [Referral intake for surgery centers](https://www.zynix.ai/use-cases/referral-intake-asc): Referral packets and faxes read, matched to the patient and case, checked for missing items and routed to your intake team before scheduling.
- [Rising-risk patient outreach for ACOs](https://www.zynix.ai/use-cases/rising-risk-patient-outreach): Turn risk flags into check-ins and booked visits before an admission, with new symptoms and barriers routed to your care team by rule.
- [SDoH screening and care navigation](https://www.zynix.ai/use-cases/sdoh-screening-care-navigation): Capture transportation, food, housing and cost barriers during patient outreach and route them to coordinators, so a screening answer leads to follow-up.
- [Pre-procedure preparation for surgery centers](https://www.zynix.ai/use-cases/surgical-scheduling-pre-procedure): Two-way outreach before each case confirms labs, medication holds, fasting and transportation, with incomplete items routed to your staff early.
